categories.name: HyperXpad Launchpad
categories.content: HyperXpad Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Printr Launchpad
categories.content: Printr is chain-abstracted token launchpad with customizable fee models and an on-chain 'Proof of Belief' staking mechanism that rewards long-term community commitment.

categories.name: Zodiac-Themed

categories.name: Tokenized Credit
categories.content: Tokens representing on-chain claims on debt instruments. Returns come from interest income and credit performance of the underlying borrowers, key risk dimensions are credit/default risk, seniority in the structure, and duration for fixed-rate instruments.

categories.name: Celebrity-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by celebrity.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Pump.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Pump.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via pump.fun.

categories.name: Argus Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Argus (https://argus.world/), the permissionless token launchpad native to Arc.

categories.name: Reserve Ecosystem
categories.content: Decentralized Token Folio (DTF) issued and created with the Reserve protocol's open-source contracts (developed by ABC Labs).

categories.name: Layer 3 (L3)
categories.content: Layer 3 protocols are built on Layer 2, enabling hosting of application-specific decentralized applications while addressing issues such as scalability, interoperability and customization.

categories.name: OpenServ Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens launched on OpenServ, a multi-chain crowdfunding platform designed for autonomous startups and Agentic Applications (aApps) built on OpenServ’s AI reasoning infrastructure.

categories.name: Robinhood Chain Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: Four.Meme Tokenized Stocks (4Stock)
categories.content: Tokens issued by Four.Meme under its 4Stock product. Each 4Stock is intended to be backed by its corresponding underlying share, purchased and held by Four.Meme through a dedicated managed account.

categories.name: MXN Stablecoin
categories.content: Stablecoins that maintain a stable value by reference to the Mexican peso (MXN).

categories.name: Parody Meme
categories.content: Meme coins which are inspired by the names of well-known brands, individuals, or cultural icons.

categories.name: Fighting Games
categories.content: Fighting game centered around combat between two or more number of characters.

categories.name: Olympus Pro Ecosystem
categories.content: Olympus Pro designed to provide liquidity management solutions for DeFi protocols. They offers a service called "bonds-as-a-service," which allows protocols to own their liquidity by offering discounted OHM tokens in exchange for liquidity provider (LP) tokens. This helps protocols to reduce their reliance on liquidity mining incentives and gain more control over their liquidity.

categories.name: MetaDAO Launchpad
categories.content: MetaDAO Launchpad (https://metadao.fi/) is a Solana-based platform designed to facilitate decentralized project launches and funding, leveraging futarchy-based governance to align community and market incentives.

categories.name: Rollups-as-a-Service (RaaS)
categories.content: Rollups-as-a-Service (RaaS) streamlines the deployment and maintenance of custom application-specific rollups by offering a simplified interface including no-code deployment options.
